name: Energy Assault FPS
desc:
Welcome to Energy Assault, a futuristic first person shooter where energy-based guns have replaced ballistic weapons.

🎯 Eliminate your opponents across multiple game modes, including Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, and Gun Game.
🔫 Level up and earn credits to unlock new guns, attachments, skins, and outfits.
💥 Fulfil your daily missions and claim unique rewards.
🏆 Compete on weekly global leaderboards for special prizes.
🎮 Available on PC, mobile, console, and in VR.
